title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Lemon & Lime Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Lemon and Lime Nic Salt offers a zesty citrus vape with a fresh, tangy profile. Lemon brings sour-sweet brightness, while Lime cuts through with sharpness. Great for fans of fruit with a kick. This Nic Salt is blended at 50VG/50PG for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for fast-acting nicotine delivery. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
